testcase.name: SQL Injection in login endpoint - https://api.example.com/auth/login (username)
testcase.failure:
Title: SQL Injection in login endpoint Severity: critical CWE: CWE-89 URL: https://api.example.com/auth/login Parameter: username
Description: The login endpoint is vulnerable to SQL injection via the username parameter.
Remediation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements.

testcase.name: Reflected XSS in search parameter - https://api.example.com/search (q)
testcase.failure:
Title: Reflected XSS in search parameter Severity: high CWE: CWE-79 URL: https://api.example.com/search Parameter: q
Description: User-supplied input in the 'q' parameter is reflected without encoding.
Remediation: HTML-encode all output, apply Content-Security-Policy.

testcase.name: Path Traversal in file download - https://api.example.com/files/download (path)
testcase.system-out:
Title: Path Traversal in file download Severity: high CWE: CWE-22 URL: https://api.example.com/files/download Parameter: path
Description: The file download endpoint does not sanitize path separators.
Remediation: Validate and canonicalize paths; restrict to an allowed directory.

testcase.failure:

testcase.name: Missing CSRF protection on state-changing endpoints - https://api.example.com/account/update
testcase.system-out:
Title: Missing CSRF protection on state-changing endpoints Severity: medium CWE: CWE-352 URL: https://api.example.com/account/update
Description: POST endpoints lack CSRF tokens.
Remediation: Implement synchronizer token pattern or SameSite cookie attribute.

testcase.name: Sensitive data exposed in API response - https://api.example.com/users/profile

failure.message: Sensitive data exposed in API response

testcase.failure:
Title: Sensitive data exposed in API response Severity: low CWE: CWE-200 URL: https://api.example.com/users/profile
Description: The profile endpoint returns internal fields (e.g. password_hash).
Remediation: Restrict response fields to only what the client needs.

testcase.name: Server-Side Request Forgery via webhook URL - https://api.example.com/webhooks (url)

failure.message: Server-Side Request Forgery via webhook URL

testcase.failure:
Title: Server-Side Request Forgery via webhook URL Severity: high CWE: CWE-918 URL: https://api.example.com/webhooks Parameter: url
Description: The webhook registration endpoint makes HTTP requests to attacker-controlled URLs.
Remediation: Validate and allowlist permitted webhook destinations.

testcase.name: Informational: Server version disclosed in headers - https://api.example.com/
testcase.system-out:
Title: Informational: Server version disclosed in headers Severity: info URL: https://api.example.com/
Description: The Server HTTP response header discloses the web server version.
Remediation: Configure the web server to suppress or obfuscate the Server header.

testcase.name: Rich Finding - https://api.example.com/users?id=1 (id)
testcase.failure:
Title: Rich Finding Severity: critical CWE: CWE-89 URL: https://api.example.com/users?id=1 Parameter: id
Description: SQL injection via the id parameter.
Remediation: Use parameterized queries.
References: https://example.com/advisory/42
